basic_details.job_title: Deputy Commissioner Imphal East Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Case Worker, Psycho-Social Counsellor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Case Worker, Psycho-Social Counsellor, Para Legal Personnel/Lawyer
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Deputy Commissioner: Imphal East District (Deputy Commissioner Imphal East), Manipur, has invited applications for 3 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. DC/(IE)/17/OSC/2019/1615. The posts include Case Worker, Psycho-Social Counsellor, Para Legal Personnel/Lawyer. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: 18 to 40 years (as on the date of notification)
age_limit.details: Age relaxation for all posts: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PWD 10 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Case Worker: woman with Bachelor in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Social Science/Psychology and at least 3 years' experience on women-related domains, resident of local community. Psycho-Social Counsellor: woman with professional degree/diploma in Psychology/Psychiatry/Neurosciences with health sector background. Para Legal Personnel/Lawyer: Degree in Law/legal training or knowledge of laws with 3 years' experience, or practising lawyer with 2 years' litigation experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Any woman having a Bachelor in Law/ Social Work/Sociology/Social science/ Psychology with at least 3 years' experience of working on women related relevant domains in a Government or Non-Government project/programme. She should be a resident of the local community. Experience required: At least 3 years' experience of working on women related relevant domains in a Government or Non-Government project/programme. Age limit: 18 to 40 years. Pay: 14,600 per month (Pre-revised GP-2800). Qualification required: Any woman having a professional degree/diploma in Psychology/ Psychiatry/ Neurosciences with a background in the health sector and preferably with at least 3 (three) years' experience of working in a Government or Non-Government health project/programme at the distr

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 14,600 per month (Pre-revised GP-2800) for each post

how_to_apply: Obtain or download the prescribed application form from https://imphaleast.nic.in/.
Fill the form and affix a self-attested recent passport size photograph.
Attach duly attested/self-attested age proof, category certificate, educational and experience certificates.
Submit the form at the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Imphal East District, Porompat, from 20.11.2026 to 11.12.2026, working days, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
important_instructions: The Deputy Commissioner reserves the right to cancel, modify or amend the notification, including the number of vacancies, without assigning any reason Candidature is liable to be rejected if particulars are found incorrect or suppressed

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Deputy Commissioner Imphal East Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Deputy Commissioner Imphal East Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Case Worker, 1 Psycho-Social Counsellor, 1 Para Legal Personnel/Lawyer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Deputy Commissioner Imphal East Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Official website https://imphaleast.nic.in/ (form also printed on pages 3-4 of the notice)) and send it to Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Imphal East District, Porompat, by submitted at the office on working days between 10:00 am and 4:00 pm, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved and OBC: Rs. 300. SC/ST: Rs. 100. PWD: No application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years (as on the date of notification). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PWD 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 14,600 per month (Pre-revised GP-2800) for Case Worker, 14,600 per month (Pre-revised GP-2800) for Psycho-Social Counsellor, 14,600 per month (Pre-revised GP-2800) for Para Legal Personnel/Lawyer.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Case Worker: woman with Bachelor in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Social Science/Psychology and at least 3 years' experience on women-related domains, resident of local community. Psycho-Social Counsellor: woman with professional degree/diploma in Psychology/Psychiatry/Neurosciences with health sector background. Para Legal Personnel/Lawyer: Degree in Law/legal training or knowledge of laws with 3 years' experience, or practising lawyer with 2 years' litigation experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Case Worker and Psycho-Social Counsellor posts are for women only. Case Worker must be a resident of the local community.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic score. Experience. Personal interview/viva-voce. Selection on the basis of academic score, experience and personal interview/viva-voce.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely on temporary contractual basis. Engagement does not entail any claim for future regularization.
